    Past allotments

    How the prediction works

    For each college we find the seat pools you are eligible for: unreserved (UR/APUR) seats, your own area's local seats, OC seats, your category's seats, EWS seats if applicable, and female-reserved seats if you are female. Every reserved candidate also competes for OC seats on merit, so your effective cutoff each year is the loosest closing rank among all your pools.

    The five yearly cutoffs are combined on a log scale, with recent years counting most (weights 0.5, 0.8, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5), and nudged by the long-run trend: cutoffs have loosened by about 3% a year as more students take NEET and AP adds seats. How much the cutoffs varied between years sets the width of the range, and that range gives your chance.

    SC sub-groups (SC-1, SC-2, SC-3) apply from 2025-26. For earlier years the combined SC cutoff is used, so SC predictions rest mainly on the last two years.

    Backtest: would it have been right?

    We hid a year, predicted it from the years before, and checked thousands of real student × college pairs.

    We said2025-26 came true2026-27 came true
    Safe96%97%
    Likely64%82%
    Borderline33%68%
    Reach6%37%
    Unlikely1%3%

    The typical error in the predicted closing rank is 12–14%. 2025-26 cutoffs tightened by about 10% and 2026-27 loosened by about 16%, which is why the "next year's competition" setting exists.

    Management quota model

    MQ seats have no caste or gender reservation. What decides your options is your rank, your home state and NRI status. Category B seats are B1 (open to all states) and B2 (AP candidates only). Category C are NRI seats. The newer government colleges also have self-finance seats (AP candidates) and NRI seats.

    The model works the same way as for CQ: the loosest closing rank among your eligible seat types each year, combined with weights favouring recent years, a 3% yearly trend, and a slightly wider range (MQ cutoffs swing more). In backtests, colleges marked Safe came through 95–96% of the time and Unlikely ones 0–1%. Likely: 62–86%. Borderline: 23–76%.

    Phase 1 is the basis. "With later rounds" applies how far closing ranks moved by the last round in 2022-23 and 2026-27: about +30% for B1, +15% for B2, +19% for self-finance seats, and almost no change for Category C.

    MQ data: Phase 1 lists for 2023-24 to 2025-26, the Phase-II list for 2022-23, and the Phase-III list for 2026-27. The separate 2026-27 Category C Phase-1 list was cross-checked: 136 of its 153 students also appear in the Phase-III list.

    What the data is

    College-wise CQ allotment lists published by Dr. NTRUHS: Phase 1 for 2022-23 to 2025-26, and the final Phase-2 list for 2026-27 (rows tagged Phase-1 there are used as that year's Phase-1 picture). Special-category seats (PwD, CAP, NCC/BSG, PMC, Anglo-Indian) are left out of the general cutoffs. Muslim-minority seats are counted only when you tick that option.

    The local-area rules changed in 2024-25: the Osmania University (OU) area quota ended and unreserved seats became AP-only. So 2022-23 and 2023-24 carry the least weight. GVP Visakhapatnam has no 2025-26 Phase-1 allotments in the list.

    Please read

    This is an estimate from past allotments, not an official NTRUHS result. Your real chance depends on this year's seat matrix, how many students apply, and the web options you and others choose. Always check the official notifications at drntr.uhsap.in before you lock your options.

    Allotment data: Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences (earlier Dr. YSR UHS), Vijayawada.
